2105-3480-5144-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3480-5144-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3480-5144-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

7084-7201-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-7201-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a 3/4 green Treefolk creature token with reach
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

34-147-4050.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-147-4050.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4549-6920--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding an additional mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Silk triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1626-3249-5268--206.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1626-3249-5268--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Headless Rider triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that Zombie from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.
728-1626-3249-5268--206.notes: Some of the one-drop Zombie creatures in the template adds more powerful results, and Gravecrawler does not require Havengul Lich.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1991-3259-4885.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1991-3259-4885.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

341-4200-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3099-3499-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4885-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
3259-4885-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4885-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

2921-4559-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2921-4559-4802-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3490-3755-7075-7295.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3755-7075-7295.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

549-3259-4460-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
549-3259-4460-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-4460-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

862-2173-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more +1/+1 counters on it

413-645-2060-3750-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
413-645-2060-3750-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Overseer enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

560-1939-2034-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Luminous Phantom triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
560-1939-2034-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

5670-6559-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
5670-6559-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

338-4268-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4268-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

997-3771-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
997-3771-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
997-3771-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability and Animar trigger.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Resolve the Geralf trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
997-3771-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2608-4499-6410.easyPrerequisites: Howlsquad Heavy does not have summoning sickness.
2608-4499-6410.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least three Goblins.
2608-4499-6410.description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat.

372-1090-3991.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1090-3991.notablePrerequisites: Restoration Angel exiled by Faceless Butcher
372-1090-3991.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Faceless Butcher and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from exile to the battlefield.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Faceless Butcher to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Faceless Butcher and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Faceless Butcher and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2919-5641-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
2919-5641-5870.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1965-4836-5642.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {2}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, copying the Omarthis spell.
Resolve the copy of the Omarthis spell, creating a token copy of Omarthis with one +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the original Omarthis spell, causing it to enter the battlefield with one +1/+1 counter on it.
The token Omarthis's first ability triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Omarthis.
The nontoken Omarthis's first ability triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Omarthis.
Repeat from step 5.

786-1734-4605.description:
Cast Flickerwisp by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Flickerwisp enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Fiend Hunter until the next end step.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield under their owner's control.
At the beginning of your end step, Flickerwisp triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Flickerwisp.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the token Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter until the token Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
When the nontoken Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Flickerwisp from exile to the battlefield.
When Flickerwisp enters the battlefield, it and Preston trigger, with Flickerwisp targeting the Fiend Hunter token.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Flickerwisp that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the token Flickerwisp enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling the Fiend Hunter token.
When the token Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning the nontoken Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

3327-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
3327-4871-5256.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to put Dargo into the command zone from your graveyard.
When Dargo dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dargo's power.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

49-232-1799-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {R}.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Priest of Urabrask on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Priest of Urabrask into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

654-1168-1651-3897-5077.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Scaretiller and another artifact, targeting Scaretiller.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Terramorphic Expanse from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Terramorphic Expanse enters the battlefield, triggering Toggo and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a Rock equipment token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Terramorphic Expanse.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability from step 1, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Terramorphic Expanse by tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to search your library for a basic land and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Toggo triggers, creating a Rock equipment token.
Repeat.

186-411-2146-4720.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {1}, adding {R}.
Repeat.

618-4358.description:
Activate the mutated Gemrazer and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.
